question.question: how to calculate my commision
question.expected_answer:
Based on the available documents, your commission as a store employee at Azadea is calculated as follows:

Commission Formula
The monthly commission is calculated using this formula:
Commission = Revenue x Commission Rate x Commissionable Working Hours

Revenue: For sales staff, this is the daily net sales generated by your store divided by the sum of commissionable working hours of all commissionable employees.
Commission Rate: This is determined by your position and specified in the salary structure.
Commissionable Working Hours: The actual hours you worked, excluding lunch breaks and any type of paid leave. The maximum commissionable hours per month is 208. Any exception must be approved by the Regional Total Rewards Manager.
Special Cases

If you temporarily support another store, your commission is based on the Revenue per Hour (RPH) of the supported store, but charged to your original store. Your working hours are counted with the supported store.
Restrictions

Commission is not paid to store support teams such as tailors, stock-keepers, technicians, and cleaners.
Example Calculation:
If your store’s daily net sales are $10,000, the total commissionable hours for all employees is 100, your commission rate is 2%, and you worked 20 commissionable hours:

Revenue per hour = $10,000 / 100 = $100
Your commission = $100 x 2% x 20 = $40
Note: The actual commission rate and sales figures will depend on your position and store performance.
